entries.wording: Tu envío ya esta preparado. Te avisaremos cuando este en camino.
entries.note: The first message, under the rail's admission step. Zeleris's older tracker showed the same scan, at the same clock, as RECEPCION TRANSPORTE: Zeleris has the parcel, which has not left yet. The shared rules would read its "en camino" as transit.

entries.wording: Tu envío está pendiente para el próximo reparto.
entries.note: Left for the next round after a delivery round, waiting at the depot.

entries.wording: No hemos podido entregarte el envío.
entries.note: Zeleris's older tracker showed it as INCIDENCIA.

entries.wording: Te hemos enviado un SMS al número de teléfono registrado en el pedido.
entries.note: A text message to the recipient after a delivery round. It moves nothing, so the parcel keeps the stage of the scan before it.
A step of the progress rail. Its current step counts when it is further along than the newest scan.
A step of the progress rail, after admission.
A step of the progress rail. Seen current on a parcel whose newest scan had it out for delivery; that scan stands.
A step of the progress rail: at a Zeleris depot, not yet on a delivery round. Seen current on a parcel whose only scan was its admission.
A step of the progress rail.
A step of the progress rail, as the tracker's help names the state: the delivery could not be completed, for missing data or an absent recipient.
A step of the progress rail, as the tracker's help names the state: the courier found nobody at the address.
A step of the progress rail, as the tracker's help names the state: a problem Zeleris has reported to the sender.
A step of the progress rail: Zeleris gives up the delivery and has told the sender. It outranks the failed attempts before it.
A step of the progress rail, with the delivery's date and time after it.
A step of the progress rail, as it reads before the delivery.
